boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct Illinois Tech research, focused-work, and collaborative-work environments with access details verified from university sources.

cards.entity_name: Quiet Zone, Paul V. Galvin Library
cards.title: Galvin Library Quiet Zone
cards.subtitle: Paul V. Galvin Library
cards.notes: Bring silent work for Galvin’s designated quiet zone, then check the library schedule and follow posted noise expectations.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet-study setting in Illinois Tech’s central library.
cards.evidence_claim: Galvin Library identifies its designated quiet zone as one of its study spaces.
cards.source_title: Get Ready for Finals Week with Galvin Library!
cards.access_notes: Check Galvin Library’s current hours before visiting; access is subject to library operations.

cards.entity_name: Group Study Rooms, Paul V. Galvin Library
cards.title: Galvin Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Paul V. Galvin Library
cards.notes: Reserve a room for a project meeting or shared problem set; bookings run from 30 minutes to two hours at a time.
cards.short_summary: Reservable rooms for Illinois Tech students working together.
cards.evidence_claim: Galvin Library offers four group study rooms and conference rooms to Illinois Tech students by reservation.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Space | Paul V. Galvin Library
cards.access_notes: Illinois Tech students need a reservation; reservations may be made up to 14 days ahead.

cards.title: Galvin Library Media Studio
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Paul V. Galvin Library
cards.notes: Book GLaMS for a presentation, recording, or editing session, and review the studio guide for current tools and use rules.
cards.short_summary: A bookable media-production workspace for audio, video, editing, and streaming.
cards.evidence_claim: GLaMS is a bookable Galvin Library studio with tools for video production, sound recording, editing, and streaming.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Space | Paul V. Galvin Library
cards.access_notes: Students, staff, and faculty can book the studio; it is on the library’s second floor next to the elevator.

cards.entity_name: Lower Interview Booth, Paul V. Galvin Library
cards.title: Lower Interview Booth
cards.subtitle: Group Study Suite, lower level
cards.notes: Reserve this individual booth for a remote interview or video conference, bring your Hawk ID, and check in at the suite desk.
cards.short_summary: A reservable lower-level private booth for individual remote professional work.
cards.evidence_claim: Galvin Library’s lower private booth is in the Group Study Suite and is reservable for Illinois Tech students’ interviews or phone/video conferences.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Space | Paul V. Galvin Library
cards.access_notes: Reserve for 15 minutes to two hours; individual study is not allowed, and a current Hawk ID is required at check-in.

cards.entity_name: Upper Interview Booth, Paul V. Galvin Library
cards.title: Upper Interview Booth
cards.subtitle: Upper level, near the main stairs
cards.notes: Use this private booth for an individual remote interview or call; plan ahead and check in with the upper-level reference desk.
cards.short_summary: A reservable upper-level private booth for individual remote professional work.
cards.evidence_claim: Galvin Library’s upper private booth is at the top of the main stairs and is reservable for Illinois Tech students’ interviews or phone/video conferences.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Space | Paul V. Galvin Library
cards.access_notes: Reserve for 15 minutes to two hours; individual study is not allowed, and booth reservations require advance planning.

cards.entity_name: University Archives and Special Collections Reading Room
cards.title: University Archives Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Lower level, Paul V. Galvin Library
cards.notes: Locate relevant finding aids before arrival, bring a laptop if useful, and use the reading room when consulting archival materials.
cards.short_summary: A supervised primary-source research room in Galvin Library.
cards.evidence_claim: University Archives and Special Collections has a reading room on Galvin Library’s lower level for consulting its non-circulating materials.
cards.source_title: Visit the Archives | University Archives and Special Collections
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Thursday, 1–5 p.m.; appointments are available before 1 p.m. on weekdays, and use is limited to archival research.

cards.entity_name: Academic Resource Center Group Study Space
cards.title: Academic Resource Center Group Study Space
cards.subtitle: Paul V. Galvin Library
cards.notes: Pair a group work session with tutoring, supplemental instruction, or an exam review when the Academic Resource Center is operating.
cards.short_summary: A group-study setting connected to Illinois Tech academic-support services.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois Tech states that its Academic Resource Center, located in Galvin Library, offers group study space.
cards.source_title: Mies Campus Services and Facilities | Illinois Tech Student Handbook
cards.access_notes: The Academic Resource Center is located in Galvin Library; check its current tutoring and semester schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Graham Resource Center
cards.subtitle: S. R. Crown Hall
cards.notes: Work among architecture books and research resources in Crown Hall, and contact the library director if you need assistance or special materials.
cards.short_summary: An architecture-focused library and research workspace in Crown Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Graham Resource Center offers space, collections, technology, and services supporting the College of Architecture’s intellectual and cultural life.
cards.source_title: Graham Resource Center | IIT College of Architecture
cards.access_notes: Academic-year hours are Monday–Thursday 9 a.m.–9 p.m., Friday 9 a.m.–7 p.m., and weekends 10 a.m.–6 p.m.; visitors may research during Crown Hall open hours.

cards.entity_name: Wireless Study Areas, McCormick Tribune Campus Center
cards.title: MTCC Wireless Study Areas
cards.subtitle: McCormick Tribune Campus Center
cards.notes: Choose an available wireless-study seat in the campus center, then keep clear of dining traffic, meetings, and scheduled events.
cards.short_summary: Campus-center study areas with wireless connectivity.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois Tech lists wireless study areas among the facilities of the McCormick Tribune Campus Center.
cards.source_title: Mies Campus Services and Facilities | Illinois Tech Student Handbook
cards.access_notes: Availability depends on campus-center operations, dining activity, meetings, and events.

cards.title: Commuter Lounge Study Space
cards.subtitle: BOG area, Hermann Hall
cards.notes: Commuter students can use this Hermann Hall lounge’s relaxing study space between classes while observing the lounge’s operating conditions.
cards.short_summary: A designated study amenity within Illinois Tech’s commuter lounge.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois Tech identifies a relaxing study space in the Commuter Lounge, located in the BOG area of Hermann Hall.
cards.access_notes: The lounge is specifically for commuter students and is open during normal operating hours.
